summary: Accounting SSO/user-flow contract wiring matches the Phase 1 contract and Sales parity. Login page carries returnTo and renders sso/forbidden messages. Proxy uses approved-origin helper. Start, callback, logout, and session routes implement 307 handoffs, safe returnTo fallback, preview-origin handoff, no-role forbidden redirect, and the Sales-parity 403 body. Release verifier asserts the documented contract. All focused test suites pass.
non_blocking_findings: apps/accounting/app/login/page.tsx: login error messages are hardcoded in English. The accounting app has no i18n infrastructure, so this matches current conventions, but localization should be tracked if the app later adopts next-intl.
apps/accounting/app/lib/sign-in-href.ts: buildSignInHref is tested but unused in production code. The proxy and login page already satisfy the returnTo contract, so this is only dead utility code.

apps/accounting/app/api/auth/session/route.ts: adds a 503 response for introspection failures. The Phase 1 contract enumerates 401/403/200; the 503 is a defensive improvement that avoids a 500, but it is not part of the listed contract.

evidence: apps/accounting/app/login/page.tsx: sign-in link reads returnTo from search params and carries it encoded to /api/auth/company/start; sso and forbidden messages render via role=alert; no dead links.

apps/accounting/proxy.ts: unauthenticated protected requests call getPublicUrl(request, '/login') to build the redirect and set returnTo=pathname+search; on helper failure it falls back to the canonical origin https://accounting.reading-advantage.com, so no redirect can target an unapproved forwarded host.

apps/accounting/app/api/auth/company/start/route.ts: returns 307 (NextResponse.redirect default for GET); parseCompanyOidcReturnTo validates returnTo; a ZodError restarts the handoff with returnTo=/ after one structured warning; preview-origin requests redirect to the callback origin with returnTo preserved.

apps/accounting/app/api/auth/callback/route.ts: after token exchange, resolveAccountingRole is checked; a no-role identity is redirected to /login?error=forbidden; every failure path expires the transaction cookie; successful flow sets the session cookie and expires the transaction cookie.

apps/accounting/app/api/auth/session/route.ts: missing token returns 401 {session: null}; valid token without Accounting role returns 403 {session: null, denied: true}; valid token with Accounting role returns 200 {session: {user}}.
apps/accounting/app/api/auth/logout/route.ts: origin is validated through getPublicOrigin; invalid origins return 403; successful logout expires the session cookie.

apps/accounting/scripts/verify-accounting-release.ts: asserts /login returns 2xx, /api/auth/session returns 401 for unauthenticated callers, and /api/auth/company/start?returnTo=https://evil.example.com returns 307 (never 500).
Sales parity: the Accounting 403 session body now matches apps/sales-advantage/app/api/auth/session/route.ts with {session: null, denied: true}.
Focused test runs passed: accounting suite 189 tests, @reading-advantage/db suite 20 tests, @reading-advantage/domain suite 3 tests.
